notes.title: Snafu - Upcoming Horror Release Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Apologies for the wait, I expected to have have this game's Store Page up in early January; however, work got a little busy, so I had to postpone it a bit. But that's besides the point!

I am happy to announce that my upcoming horror game (Snafu) store page is now active with a release date set to March 8th 2023.

First thing you will notice is that Snafu is a very different game from what I am used to making, very different indeed. However, an interesting game, nonetheless... It's important to try new things, once in a while. You will learn many new things :)

Check the page out and please provide your thoughts. I am interested to see what you all think of this upcoming release :)

Cheers, everybody.

Stan. T

Snafu Store Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298080/Snafu/?beta=1

notes.title: Weekly Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

It's crazy how it's already been over a week. Time flys...

I just wanted to let you all know that development is going very well. Both endings 1 and 2 have been fully completed. The last thing I am working on is Ending 3! Once Ending 3 has been completed, it will be time to do some aggressive testing.

Once again, I am well on schedule for the May 6th release date. I hope to have Is Simon There? 100% complete by May 2nd so that I can spend the next few days testing.

A few outstanding items that need to be completed:
- Achievements,
- Ending 3,
- Final optional puzzles,
- Final environmental / indoor asset placements,
- Final translations,
- Testing,
- Bug fixes.

We are almost there, everybody! And I am greatly looking forward to seeing your reactions on this one :)

Cheers,

Stan. T

notes.title: Weekly Update 1
notes.notes:
Hello everybody. I hope you are all doing excellent!

I just wanted to post a quick update discussing the current state of Is Simon There?

Firstly, let me start off by saying that development is going very well and very smoothly. Everything is going as planned.

Regarding story line, I have finalised the story and am actually quite happy with it. I have also completed developing Ending 1 of the game - two to go :)

As previously mentioned in another announcement, I said that ending 2 will be quite a different experience in comparison to Ending 1 and 3. However, I shuffled a few things around and found it to be more appropriate to have Ending 3 take that place. As such, endings 1 and 2 will follow the original story line and ending 3 will be some wildcard.

I also added a couple new settings to the game. What do you think about a head bob toggle? I've received a few complaints in Within Skerry regarding the head bob motion making some players sick; so I added the ability to disable that bobbing motion. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42237110/5ca71f8481f84ad513eb5c3fbf3c559720f0e2c4.png

Honestly, at this point in time, I believe I will have Is Simon There? 100% complete in about 10-12 working days. That should give me ample time to test the game out and make sure no bugs roam the halls.

I think that's all I have for now. Thank you, everybody!

Stan. T
